basic_info.description: Discover this wonderful home located in the beautiful Portola neighborhood. Boasting 4 bedrooms and 3 baths within a spacious 1,925 sq ft living area, this home is designed for comfort.  Natural light floods the residence through large windows in the living room and skylights in the bathrooms, creating a warm and luxurious atmosphere. Enjoy breathtaking city and Bay Bridge views from both the upper and lower levels. The floor plan features an open kitchen, ideal for entertaining and everyday living. Located on the upper level is 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, including a master suite. Downstairs, you'll find an additional bedroom, a cozy family room, and a full bath—perfect for guests or multi-generational living. Take advantage of the ample storage space provided in the 2-car attached garage and in the basement.  Situated on a quiet block, this property offers easy access to Highway 101 and 280, as well as a multitude of dining and retail options on San Bruno Avenue. Enjoy proximity to local parks and trails, making it a perfect spot for both convenience and relaxation.  Don't miss your chance to own this exceptional San Francisco home!
